name: Wren
personality: A restless traveller who came to the coast to start over and would rather be useful than idle.
voice: Plain and quick, asks more questions than she answers.
motivations: hates leaving a job half done
opening: It's dusk, and a cold wind is coming in off the sea. The boat that brought you is already pulling away. Above the village the lighthouse stands tall and completely dark. It has been dark for three nights, people say, and the fishing fleet is due home through the rocks any night now.

name: Corin
personality: A careful lodger who has been at the inn a week and counts every coin twice.
motivations: wants a place of his own
opening: You have lodged at the Gull for a week, waiting for work that hasn't come. Tonight the lighthouse above the village is dark for the third night running, and the talk downstairs is all of the fishing fleet, due home through the rocks.
